answer: Proof of Stake provides robust Sybil resistance for AI agents by requiring capital commitment to secure the network. An attacker cannot simply forge thousands of identities, as they must lock tokens to participate. This financial barrier functions like a walnut shell protecting the core kernel of the ledger. By anchoring identity to wealth, the mechanism acts as a jetty against the tide of cheap automated accounts, forcing any malicious actor to bear the tangible cost of significant asset depletion.
